T2_hero.h1: PhD lx System — platform for IFA and EIA automation
T2_hero.lead: An open Bio-Rad system that automates routine stages of serology testing.

T3_about.h2: What PhD lx System is and who it is for
T3_about.text: PhD lx System is an open Bio-Rad automation platform for IFA and EIA processing. It supports Bio-Rad and third-party protocols and helps automate routine stages of preparing and performing serology assays. A programming wizard helps configure protocols, while bidirectional ASTM connectivity through RS-232 or TCP/IP allows worklists to be imported from an LIS.

items.text: The system handles IFA and EIA assays while supporting Bio-Rad and third-party protocols. Magnetic racks and a reagent rack help organize reagents during a run.
According to the manufacturer, the system records audit trails, imports LIS worklists, and automatically removes air bubbles. This gives the laboratory a record of actions performed during a run.
A dark cover protects sensitive assays from light, dust, and drafts. The microplate reader operates with 405, 450, 550, and 620 nm filters.

T10_faq.h2: PhD lx System questions and answers

items.q: Which methods does PhD lx System automate?
items.a: The system automates IFA and EIA processing. It supports Bio-Rad and third-party protocols.

items.q: Which filters does the PhD lx microplate reader have?
items.a: The reader has 405, 450, 550, and 620 nm filters.

items.q: Can PhD lx System connect to an LIS?
items.a: Yes. It supports bidirectional ASTM connectivity through RS-232 or TCP/IP.

items.q: Who supplies and maintains PhD lx System in Ukraine?
items.a: LabWell is an official Bio-Rad distributor in Ukraine. It helps select the most effective solution for your needs and provides supply, installation, staff training, warranty and post-warranty maintenance, and application support.

T12_contact.text: Describe your IFA and EIA assays, protocols, and workflow, and we will help assess a suitable PhD lx System configuration and LIS connection.
